Package com.saicone.types.parser

Class CollectionParser<T extends Collection<E>,E>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.AllocParser<T>
com.saicone.types.parser.CollectionParser<T,E>
Type Parameters:
T - the type result of collection.
E - the type of elements in the collection.
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeParser<T>, Function<Object,T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ListParser, SetParser
public abstract class CollectionParser<T extends Collection<E>,E> extends AllocParser<T>
Represents a parser that convert objects into a collection.
